name: Sarah Langford
bio: One of NSW's most respected custom furniture studio owners, Sarah shares her journey building a career in a male-dominated industry — the challenges, the wins, and the timber species she can't live without.

name: Dr. Mike Parrish
bio: Dr. Parrish breaks down the occupational health risks woodworkers face every day — dust, noise, chemical exposure, and the musculoskeletal injuries that end careers if left unchecked.

name: Robbo Williams
bio: Third-generation sawmiller from Far North Queensland, Robbo talks about the realities of running a portable mill business — the good seasons, the bad ones, and why he wouldn't swap it for anything.

name: Jess Carver
bio: Jess pioneered her unique style of resin-and-timber wall art and turned it into a six-figure business. She breaks down the process, the failures, and how she markets her work without a gallery.

name: Tom Strickland
bio: A psychologist who works specifically with tradespeople and men in blue-collar industries, Tom talks about what he hears in his practice — and the conversations blokes desperately need to start having.

name: Andy & Lisa Mao
bio: Husband-and-wife team who build entirely off-grid, fully timber-framed tiny homes. A fascinating look at how sustainable design meets craftsmanship — and how a couple survives building together.
